mapper.select: WITH due AS (SELECT id FROM local_outbox WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND available_at <= #{now} ORDER BY available_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit}) UPDATE local_outbox o SET attempts=o.attempts+1,available_at=CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) + (CAST(#{leaseMillis} AS bigint) * interval '1 millisecond') FROM due WHERE o.id=due.id RETURNING o.id,o.claim_id,o.effect,o.payload::text AS payload_json,o.attempts,o.available_at,o.traceparent
mapper.update: UPDATE local_outbox SET delivered_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND delivered_at IS NULL
UPDATE local_outbox SET last_error=left(#{error},240),available_at=#{retry} WHERE id=#{id} AND delivered_at IS NULL
UPDATE payment_requests SET status='CONFIRMED',reference=#{reference},confirmed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND status='REQUESTED'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_requests WHERE claim_id=#{claimId})
SELECT claim_id,reference,confirmed_at FROM payment_requests WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND status='CONFIRMED'
